title: Vinod's hidden background as friend of Gandhi and Bombay professor

tellings.quote: Vinod was his name. He He was friends with Gandhi, right?

plain: A man known as Dr. Vinod, who turns up in a story about a CIA scientist who says he contacted an alien council in the early 1950s, had a hidden past as a friend of Gandhi and a professor in Bombay. The researcher Greg Malatzi brings this up on the show without naming a source, half asking it: "He was friends with Gandhi, right?" The point would be that a figure in the contact story had more weight and standing than he showed.
